item.title: Evening light linked to later sleep in a small study
item.description: Researchers followed 120 adults for two weeks and found that brighter evening light was linked with falling asleep later. The team says the result needs confirming in larger groups.

item.title: Walking breaks & blood sugar: what a lab trial saw
item.description: Short walking breaks every half hour lowered after-meal blood sugar in 30 volunteers compared with sitting.
